find:
const arenaAllowed = (id: string, players: number, mode: 'ffa' | 'teams'): boolean =>
    versusMapChoices(players, mode, VERSUS_CATALOG, unlocked()).includes(id);
why: The setup store reads its unlock once, when it is built, instead of at every check (issue #983). The store lives as long as the page, so a level cleared after boot does not reach it: the player picks the newly unlocked board, the pane's own live check offers it and the match runs on it, but `set` quietly stores Random, so the next page load has forgotten the choice. The same tidy-looking hoist of a getter as versus-unlock-snapshotted-when-the-hud-is-built, on the store's side.
